messages:
Nina Patel: Quick SEO checklist for Monday launch post + webinar: canonical decision, 3 redirect rules for promos, JSON-LD event, and two meta desc variants. 10 min?

Owen Li: I can do redirects. Prefer 302 for promo links, 301 only for permanent archive pages. Will add rollback tags.

Renee Vargas: Ill draft JSON-LD (Event + FAQ) and OG/Twitter cards. Will include a small unit test to check JSON-LD present on page.

Tom Becker: Keywords from benchmark we should use: "production inference webinar", "reduce inference latency", "inference cost best practices". Ill write two meta descs (conversion + educational).

Nina Patel: Canonical rules: /register = primary. /guestlist keep self-canonical unless content fully duplicates then point to /register. Add rel=canonical only if parity > 80%.

Owen Li: Redirect sketch:
/webinar/social -> /guestlist?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=may_launch 302
/guestlist/submit -> /register?utm_source=guestlist_form&utm_campaign=may_launch 302
/blog/webinar-2026 -> /register?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=webinar 301
Rollback: remove query params and restore original target.

Renee Vargas: JSON-LD sample I'll include in PR (and tests):
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-18T17:00:00Z","eventAttendanceMode":"https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://www.redwood.com/register"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","price":"0","priceCurrency":"USD"}}
Also adding FAQPage markup to surface Q&A in SERPs.

Tom Becker: Dropping meta variants in the content doc now, pinging growth for a quick pick.

Nina Patel: Action owners: Owen - redirect PR + nginx rules; Renee - JSON-LD + OG tags + tests; Tom - meta copy + KW sets; Ill coordinate UTM matrix. Reconvene Tue 9am after staging crawl.

seo-bot: staging-crawl scheduled for 2026-04-07T03:00Z. Results will post to #marketing-crawl-results.

Owen Li: Opening redirect PR now.

Renee Vargas: Will include unit tests asserting JSON-LD and OG tags are present before merge.

Nina Patel: Thanks team, :thumbsup:
